name: Entity Reference Unrestricted Label
description: Provides an entity reference field formatter that bypass the entity access and shows the entity label to any user.
project_description:
¿Have you ever needed to show the existence of a referenced entity while keeping the access controls in place? 

 This module adds a simple field formatter for entity reference fields that will show the entity label to all users, regardless of the entity access result.

 Examples: 
 An e-learning platform that has an entity reference field allowing editors to show the available exams for a given course, but the exams entities are only visible to registered users.

 A newspaper or magazine might have some content only available for registered users, but it will need to be able to show the referenced content labels elsewhere and even if the user is anonymous.

 Security 
 ¡Beware! Use this module carefully as it can expose sensitive information.
